# Ezekiel 2 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 2:9 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-looked, and-behold, a-hand [was] stretched-out to-me, and-behold, in-it [was] a-scroll-of a-book. |
| LOGOS | And when I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me, and behold, a scroll of a book was in it. |
| PNEUMA | Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out toward me, holding a scroll. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 2:2 (overlap: 11%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-spirit entered into-me when-He-spoke to-me, and-it-stood-me upon my-feet, and-I-heard [the one]-speaking to-me. |
| LOGOS | And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me. |
| PNEUMA | As He spoke, the Spirit entered me and lifted me to my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

## 2:10 (overlap: 11%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-He-spread-it before-me, and-it [was] written front and-back, and-written upon-it [were] lamentations and-mourning and-woe. |
| LOGOS | And He spread it before me. And it had writing on the front and on the back, and there were written on it words of lamentation and mourning and woe. |
| PNEUMA | He unrolled it in front of me, and both sides were covered with writing — words of grief, mourning, and doom. |

| LOGOS | But you, son of man, hear what I say to you. Be not rebellious like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you." |
